column1: # plan_pin.tsv — the verified 16-shard plan that a whole-suite `just ctp sql`
# keeps (ADR 0017 D9; resolve_pin in scripts/ctp_run.sh). One "<unit>\t<shard>"
# row per cases dir ("<dir>#<k>" for a split.tsv chunk).
# Source: run sql-20260924T044116Z-3751818, engine develop c63a3b993 (optdebug),
# testcases develop 4004f1e13bce: PASSED 17,462 cases over 16 shards, with
# medium 975/975 beside it. The units that run keep these shards whatever their
# weights are now; a unit missing here is placed by LPT around them.
# Re-pin only on purpose (a weight refresh, a big testcases change, or the
# runner warning that the heaviest shard is over 110% of the mean): run with
# CTP_ARGS=--no-plan-pin, verify that plan with two full runs, then copy that run's
# <out>/plan_pin.tsv over this file and fix up this header.
